create_policy_settings_config: create a PolicySettingsConfig dataclass instance with exist, effect, principal, actions, and resources fields
use_effect_allow: use the Effect enum ALLOW value to set an Allow effect on a bucket policy config
use_effect_deny: use the Effect enum DENY value to set a Deny effect on a bucket policy config
configure_bucket_policy_allow: configure a bucket policy to allow specific actions and resources using PolicySettingsConfig
configure_bucket_policy_deny: configure a bucket policy to deny access for a principal using PolicySettingsConfig
